title: PureHealth subsidiary SEHA Clinics converts flagship Saadiyat facility to 24-hour operations
summary: The extended hours follow the clinic’s launch earlier this year and form part of SEHA Clinics’ efforts to improve access to preventive and community-based healthcare across Abu Dhabi.

contentHtml:
UAE—SEHA Clinics, a subsidiary of PureHealth and one of the UAE’s largest providers of primary and specialty healthcare services, has extended the operating hours of its flagship Saadiyat Clinic to 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

The move gives residents and visitors on Saadiyat Island access to primary healthcare services at any time, strengthening the clinic’s role in providing convenient, patient centred care within the community.

The extended hours follow the clinic’s launch earlier this year and form part of SEHA Clinics’ efforts to improve access to preventive and community-based healthcare across Abu Dhabi.

The expansion also responds to growing demand for accessible medical services in Saadiyat, one of Abu Dhabi’s rapidly developing residential and cultural destinations.

Wider access to primary care

Under the new 24-hour schedule, patients can seek medical advice, diagnosis and treatment throughout the day and night.

The service is designed to provide a convenient option for people with non emergency medical needs who may otherwise have to visit hospital emergency departments.

By making primary care available around the clock, the clinic can also support patients who require timely medical attention outside conventional working hours.

This approach enables people to access care closer to home while supporting continuity of treatment and ongoing management of their health needs.

The extended service is particularly relevant to families, residents and visitors who may require medical attention during evenings, weekends or public holidays.

Comprehensive healthcare services

SEHA Clinics Saadiyat provides a range of medical services designed to meet the needs of individuals and families.

These include family medicine, paediatrics, dermatology, women’s health, physiotherapy, nutrition and cardiology, alongside other primary and specialty care services.

The clinic combines these services in a modern setting designed to make healthcare more comfortable and convenient for patients.

Its hospitality-inspired environment offers a concierge-style experience, with an emphasis on personalised care and easy access to medical services.

SEHA Clinics said the expanded operating hours reflect its focus on bringing healthcare services closer to communities as demand for accessible medical care continues to grow across Abu Dhabi.

The 24/7 service at Saadiyat Clinic allows patients to seek care when they need it rather than being limited by conventional clinic hours.

The expansion adds to SEHA Clinics’ healthcare network and supports its efforts to provide accessible medical care across the emirate.
